techs.name: Aperture Awakening
uniques: Starting tech
Enables embarkation for land units

civilopediaText.text: Each year the clan opens the apertures of its youths (开窍) with a Hope Gu. The ones who open become Gu Masters; the rest stay mortal and work.

Primeval stones come out of spirit springs. A clan that cannot tap its spring cannot pay its Gu Masters, so this knowledge comes before almost everything else.
Every Gu eats one food and nothing else (养蛊). Raising Gu is bookkeeping: count the mouths, count the food, and never let the second number fall below the first.

Villages brew wine (酿酒) for mortals and for the Gu that drink it. A jar of good wine has bought more than one Gu Master's loyalty.
Gu are refined (炼蛊) from a recipe and its materials, with the Gu Master's own essence worn into them. A failed refinement wastes every material and stone put into it; nobody refunds the loss.
The step from rank one to rank two. Essence turns from copper to iron, and so does the price of keeping the cultivator alive.

civilopediaText.text: The clan's inheritance of the theft path (偷道传承). Only a clan with a living Theft Master can study it. Its Masters gain 15% more XP, and none of them reaches Grandmaster attainment without it. It was founded in Medieval Antiquity (中古) by Thieving Heaven Venerable.
Formations (蛊阵) bind many Gu and a store of primeval stones into one structure. Qing Mao's villages still trusted their stockade walls; a clan that learns formations holds what walls cannot.
The step to rank three. Few reach it, and a clan spends years of stones on each one who does.

techs.name: Merchant Caravans
uniques: Enables Open Borders agreements

civilopediaText.text: Merchant clans send caravans (商队) up the mountain with goods, Gu and news. Their protection is paid for, and their prices are not negotiable.
Dead Gu Masters leave inheritances behind: stores, techniques, trials. Every inheritance has a reason to exist, and the reason is rarely the heir's welfare.
Several Gu used together in one technique make a killer move, stronger than any of them alone. The cost is paid in essence, and the essence comes from stones.
The great clans of the Southern Border (超级家族) dwarf any mountain village, and the Shang clan runs a whole market city. Trade is how they turn other people's wars into their own income.

techs.name: Beast Enslavement
uniques: When defeating a [Beast] unit, earn [10] Gold and recruit it <when number of [[Gold] Per Turn] is more than [4]>

civilopediaText.text: Some Gu Masters bind beasts to their will (奴道). A captured wolf is an army that never complains, as long as it is fed.
The step to rank four. On a mountain of three villages, a single rank-four master is a deciding weight.
Rank five essence (紫晶真元) condenses like crystal. Opens the Rank Five Gu Master.

Heaven, earth and human qi (天气, 地气, 人气) must meet in balance for a mortal to become an immortal. From now on your land gathers heaven qi, your springs and hills earth qi, and your people and battles human qi.
Calamities (灾劫) come on a schedule and can be prepared for. Knowing them is the last preparation for the ascension: a rank-five master may now try it (the Ascension promotion).

An immortal Gu recipe (仙蛊方) is the plan for a Gu unique in the world; even a complete one costs a fortune. Opens the rank-six immortal Gu, each a world wonder bought with production and green grape essence.
Rank-seven essence (红枣仙元). An immortal that has survived a heavenly tribulation may climb to rank seven with dao marks tier II and 60 green grape essence (on Standard).
Recipes for rank-seven immortal Gu, bought with red date essence.

The rank-eight aperture (洞天). A rank-seven immortal that has survived another tribulation may climb to rank eight with dao marks tier III and 60 red date essence (on Standard); its blessed land becomes a grotto-heaven.
Recipes for rank-eight immortal Gu, bought with white lychee essence.
A Venerable refines the world's dao marks of its path (道主). Opens the Venerable Ascension and Eternal Life.
A Gu House (仙蛊屋) is a formation-path killer move built as a fortress. Opens the Gu Houses (three for any clan, a fourth for the Heavenly Court), each needing its key immortal Gu.
Recipes for rank-nine immortal Gu; fewer than ten exist at a time. They cost yellow apricot essence, which only a Venerable makes.

A Venerable's will reaches every region. While a Venerable lives, its clan thrives (+20% production, +3 happiness) and every other clan fights 10% weaker, loses 2 happiness, and meets the Venerable's Shadow.

techs.name: Dao Comprehension
uniques: Can be continually researched

civilopediaText.text: Insight into the Great Dao (悟道) has no end. Each step teaches how little the previous one understood.
